name: Agent Performance renders from the sidebar with seeded runs, table and cost breakdown
description: Opens Agent Performance from the GLOBAL sidebar and confirms the page shows the seeded agents and both cost donuts. Read-only: the screen only reads stored runs and findings, so no model call and no API key are needed. Depends on the performance demo seed (`pnpm db:seed` seeds ~65 days of runs for the acme/payments-api agents). Numbers are not asserted because run times are relative to 'now'.

steps.label: click Agent Performance in the sidebar
a seeded agent is in the table
an agent without runs is a row, not an empty page
